goal: Prove a renderer-free WoW 1.12.1 build 5875 client can authenticate and enter a world session as an Android x86_64 executable in a PC emulator, including read-only Auction House and Mail protocol access.
notes: Isolated emulator-first probe. It does not modify current MarketWorker/AUX DLL ownership, parallel_candidate, loader or updater delivery. POC-01 is PASSED on exact SHA fe9509df1cd770a352b7a8451457efbe31f8db2f, Android build run 37210672434, preflight run 37210672427, artifact 11306227666. User gameplay test on 2026-10-04 showed custom SMSG_ADDON_INFO skipped, WORLD auth PASS with build 5875, 3 characters enumerated, character login, SMSG_LOGIN_VERIFY_WORLD PASS and final 'PASS: entered world session'. The simultaneous desktop session on the same account was disconnected when the headless world session authenticated, providing independent server-side session acceptance evidence. AUTH login remains build 7272 while CMSG_AUTH_SESSION uses world build 5875, matching the working Windows client disassembly. POC-02 read-only Auction House is PASSED on exact SHA 4c1aa912537095a5be7793a82c85955bc9fe47f9, Android build run 37213597343, preflight run 37213597341, artifact 11307572273. User emulator test on 2026-10-04 reached SMSG_LOGIN_VERIFY_WORLD PASS, discovered nearby auctioneer GUIDs from object updates, completed MSG_AUCTION_HELLO, received and parsed SMSG_AUCTION_LIST_RESULT with page0_records=50, total=62348 and payload=3208, printed concrete auction records, and ended with '[AH] POC-02 READ-ONLY PASS' plus final world-session PASS. No bid, buy, sell or cancel operation was implemented or sent. POC-03 read-only Mailbox is PASSED on exact SHA 49a12df792af1036f4f9e491d6101f1b5dbec1e3, Android build run 37214869603 PASS, parallel feature preflight run 37214869614 PASS, artifact 11307689018 (sha256:3691f01046dcc74e101679c30cd1096141de399822152b0d8606b535cab5c46a). User emulator evidence on 2026-10-04 showed two transient world/login resets followed by successful retry on the third attempt, SMSG_LOGIN_VERIFY_WORLD PASS, '[AH] POC-02 READ-ONLY PASS', then CMSG_GET_MAIL_LIST to the nearby Booty Bay mailbox GUID 0xF11002A4A5002A0C, SMSG_MAIL_LIST_RESULT PASS with 8 parsed mails (items and auction proceeds), '[MAIL] POC-03 READ-ONLY PASS', and final world-session PASS. The failed earlier mailbox attempts were caused by selecting a different detected mailbox outside the server interaction radius; the nearest mailbox at the logged player position succeeded. POC-03 remained read-only: no mail money/item collection, delete, mark-read, return or send operation was implemented or sent. POC-04 resilience is PASSED on exact tested SHA 3a6926be6e4ac846ade5724347f1e7df88c79728, Android build run 37219899584 PASS, parallel feature preflight run 37219899481 PASS, artifact 11310042291 (sha256:d15a97afaee9e14a21feae363759507b3cf31d204a99cd1905e098b148fdf5d0). User emulator evidence on 2026-10-04 completed a 300-second persistent-world soak after multiple deliberately tolerated transient connection resets, finished on session attempt 10/60, handled 9906 drained world packets, received matching SMSG_PONG responses through CMSG_PING seq=10, rebuilt full auth/realm/character state after disconnects, re-established read-only AH and Mail access, and ended with '[RESILIENCE] POC-04 SOAK PASS duration=300s drained_packets=9906', '[RESILIENCE] POC-04 RECONNECT/KEEPALIVE PASS attempts=10', and '[WOW112-ANDROID-PROBE] PASS: persistent world session'. AH and Mail remained read-only throughout POC-04.
